technique_name: Given the context, how would you design an AI-based digital assistant?
description: The AI-based digital assistant would first be designed with a natural language processing (NLP) system, which would allow it to accurately interpret commands given to it by the user. Then, it would need to be trained with data related to the tasks it is expected to perform. For example, if it is expected to help customers book flights, then it would need to be trained on airfare data.
